description.p: Transforme imagens ISO em pendrives inicializáveis com simplicidade e segurança.
Native Linux application based on Rufus and Lufus. Original projects and component licenses are retained.
Exact-length RAW and compressed verification, bounded progress events and cancellation during blocked verification reads. New corruption, compression and cancellation regression tests.
Fix Zorin OS persistent-media creation with bounded internal ISO link resolution, preflight checks and expanded-size accounting. Real SteamOS, Kali and Zorin image validation.
Stronger target validation, system/swap protection, reliable completion and cancellation, explicit Lufus credit and portable integration fixes.
Localized release notes, open-source license summaries and current portable dependency notices.
Ricardo Barreto developer credit and four interface languages: Brazilian Portuguese, English, Simplified Chinese and Spanish.
TuxFlash identity, supplied penguin icon, and native Linux media creation.
